items.title: Tycoon 2FA Phishing Kit Disrupted by Microsoft, Europol and Partners
items.description: Microsoft, Europol, and partners have dismantled the Tycoon 2FA phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) platform, seizing 330 domains used for credential theft and MFA bypass. This coordinated action disrupts a service active since 2023 that powered tens of millions of phishing emails monthly. Tycoon 2FA enabled cybercriminals to bypass multifactor authentication (MFA) via adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM)…
